GESR MEK received 113 application. 34 Startups were selected to join the boot camp which helped young innovative entrepreneurs develop their business and financial plans and include creative ideas to their projects and pitching. GESR MEK received 113 application. 34 Startups were selected to join the boot camp which helped young innovative entrepreneurs develop their business and financial plans and include creative ideas to their projects and pitching. Taking health precautions forced by COVID19 the 12 days boot camp was online and attended by 75 individuals representing 34 startups.
